{{Short description|German mathematician (born 1961)}}
'''Heide Gluesing-Luerssen''' (born 1961)<ref>Birth year from [http://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/n2001016076.html Library of Congress catalog entry], retrieved 2018-12-07.</ref> is a German mathematician specializing in [[algebraic coding theory]]. She is currently the Royster Research Professor at [[University of Kentucky]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://math.as.uky.edu/users/hglue2 |title=Heide Gluesing-Luerssen |publisher=uky.edu |accessdate=December 18, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.uky.edu/CouncilEPC/endowed.php |title=Endowed Chairs |publisher=uky.edu |accessdate=December 18, 2016 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20161014101842/https://www.uky.edu/CouncilEPC/endowed.php |archivedate=October 14, 2016 }}</ref>

==Education and career==
Gluesing-Luerssen earned her doctorate in 1991 from the [[University of Bremen]], and taught in the mathematics department of the [[University of Oldenburg]] from 1993 to 2004. While there, she completed a [[habilitation]] in 2000. She moved to the [[University of Groningen]] in 2004, and to Kentucky in 2007.<ref>Author biography from {{citation
 | last1 = Gluesing-Luerssen | first1 = Heide
 | last2 = Weaver | first2 = Elizabeth A.
 | date = February 2011
 | doi = 10.1109/tit.2010.2094850
 | issue = 2
 | journal = IEEE Transactions on Information Theory
 | pages = 738–751
 | title = Linear Tail-Biting Trellises: Characteristic Generators and the BCJR-Construction
 | volume = 57| arxiv = 1003.4539| s2cid = 945677
 }}.</ref>

==Contributions==
She is the author of the book ''Linear delay-differential systems with commensurate delays: an algebraic approach'' (Lecture Notes in Mathematics 1770, Springer-Verlag, 2002).<ref>Review of ''Linear delay-differential systems with commensurate delays'' by Zbigniew Bartosiewicz (2003), {{MR|1874340}}.</ref>
